entities.label: Institution
entities.summary: The Muhyuddin Andavar Mosque is a Sunni Hanafi Friday mosque, located in the town of Thiruppanandal, in the Thanjavur district of the state of Tamil Nadu, India. It is part of a complex that houses a mausoleum, a cemetery, and shops that are rented out to generate income for the running of the mosque.
